summary: Tested new Reports feature (7 report types × CSV+PDF). Backend: 19/19 pytest PASS — all endpoints work correctly (deal-blotter, settlement, open-positions, audit-trail, user-activity, volume-summary, client-activity) with proper filters, group_by, RBAC (403 for trader on admin-only reports), and Content-Disposition headers. Frontend: /reports page renders correctly (trader sees 5 cards, admin sees all 7). RBAC visibility works. However, ALL export buttons fail with HTTP 401 due to AuthContext not exposing the JWT token to ReportsPage.

integration_issues.flow: Report export (CSV & PDF) — ALL 7 report types affected
integration_issues.issue: All export buttons trigger 401 Unauthorized. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/auth.js exposes only { user, login, logout, loading } via AuthContext but ReportsPage.jsx destructures `const { user, token } = useAuth()` — token is undefined, so the fetch sends `Authorization: Bearer undefined`. UI shows toast 'Export failed: HTTP 401' on every click.

action_items: FIX (1-line): In /app/frontend/src/lib/auth.js, expose token in the AuthContext value — e.g., add a `token` state synced to localStorage('fx_token') and include it in the Provider value: `<AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, token, login, logout, loading }}>`. Update login() to also `setToken(res.data.token)` and logout() to clear. Alternatively, refactor ReportsPage to use the axios `api` instance with `responseType: 'blob'` (cleaner — existing interceptor already injects the bearer token).
critical_code_review_comments: ReportsPage.jsx uses raw fetch() + hand-rolled Authorization header instead of the shared axios `api` instance that already has a request interceptor for token injection. Switching to axios with responseType:'blob' would eliminate the current bug and also get the 401-redirect interceptor behavior for free.
Backend /api/reports/volume-summary and /api/reports/client-activity bypass _get_deals_for_report helper and duplicate the trader-scoping logic — consider centralizing.

In server.py line 1055/1078, date_to filter appends 'T23:59:59' to created_at — fine for ISO strings but brittle if created_at is stored as BSON date; currently works because audit_logs.created_at is stored as ISO string.

rca of the issue: RCA for the 401 frontend export bug: ReportsPage.jsx (line 241) destructures `token` from useAuth(), but auth.js's AuthContext.Provider value only contains { user, login, logout, loading }. `token` is therefore always undefined inside ReportsPage. The `fetch(..., { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })` call sends literally 'Bearer undefined', which backend's JWT middleware rejects with 401. Reproduction: login as admin → /reports → click any CSV/PDF button → toast 'Export failed: HTTP 401' and network tab shows 401 on the /api/reports/* request. Mitigation options: (1) expose token in AuthContext value, (2) read localStorage.getItem('fx_token') directly in ReportsPage, or (3) switch ReportsPage to use the axios `api` instance (recommended — interceptor already attaches token).
